Why Invest in a Business Laptop?

A business laptop is more than just a device for getting work done. It is an investment that supports employee productivity, protects company information, and keeps daily operations running smoothly. ASUS ExpertBook business laptops are designed with these needs in mind:

items: Business-grade security: ASUS ExpertBook laptops feature NIST SP 800-193-compliant BIOS with five-year hardware, firmware, and driver update support, helping businesses maintain device protection against emerging security threats without requiring additional licensing or IT intervention.

Tested for durability: Having passed 24 MIL-STD-810H military-standard tests and more than 150 ASUS in-house tests, ASUS ExpertBook laptops are engineered to withstand accidental water spills on keyboard, the demands of daily business use from office work to frequent commutes and travel.

Best after-sales support: With a default three-year warranty, extendable up to five years, including battery and charger warranty coverage. ASUS also has more than 100 service centers nationwide and offers priority servicing through the ASUS Business Support Program.

AI-powered productivity: Select models feature ASUS MyExpert, an on-device AI solution for file searches, meeting summaries, and real-time translation, while Copilot+ PC-certified models offer access to advanced AI-powered productivity features.

blocks.text: With the right combination of performance, protection, and support, ASUS ExpertBook laptops help professionals stay productive and keep work moving in businesses.
